item.title: Why Should Companies Develop a Multi-Cloud Strategy?
item.description: Digital transformation has been accelerated by the advent of public cloud providers like AWS, GCP and Azure. Companies are leveraging this technology by migrating legacy application from on-premise data centers to public cloud and are developing new software solutions using a cloud-native principles. Next to established cloud architectures like private, public and hybrid-cloud some companies are also looking forward multi-cloud solutions, which is the use of multiple public cloud providers at once.
